annotations.title: Ask Ploa's support, through the person

description: Drafts a message to Ploa's support for the person to approve: a problem with Ploa itself, billing, a refund, privacy. Agents never write to support themselves, so it waits for the person, and goes out under their name and email once they approve it on ploa.dev (never in advance, not even for an autonomous agent). Put in what support needs: what was tried, the app, the release or run ID, and the error word for word. For something Ploa doesn't cover that needs no answer, ploa_gap_report.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.

message.description: The message, as the person would send it.
